reviews.text:
★★★★★

Just Pray is a thoughtful app for anyone trying to stay consistent with salah. I especially appreciate the Fajr alarm that encourages you to get up and the reminders to pray before getting distracted by other apps. The prayer guides are helpful for anyone learning or reviewing how to pray. May Allah reward the people who created it and make it beneficial for many others.

reviews.title: Grateful
reviews.text:
Really grateful to have found Just Pray. The app is simple, useful, and thoughtfully made, and I appreciate that it’s designed to help Muslims stay consistent with their prayers and daily worship.
I especially appreciate the generosity of the developer in making the app accessible to people who may not currently be able to afford it. That kind of consideration means a lot.
May Allah reward everyone involved in creating Just Pray and put barakah in this project. I’m looking forward to continuing to use it, inshaAllah. 🤲

reviews.title: Best Prayer App, Amazing Founder
reviews.text: I downloaded this app only a couple of days ago, and I have to say that hands down, this is the best prayer/tracker app for all Muslims. I love the Fajir alarm feature as it helped me to wake for Fajir without wasting time and waking up late. This app also has other features that are incredibly helpful, especially for new/revert Muslims, having a learning section in the app that includes teaching how to pray Salah, make wudhu, learn Surah Al- Fatiha, and more. Overall this app is amazing and beautifully made, and there is so much more I can say about it. May Allah bless everyone who contributed in making this app, Ameen ❤️

reviews.title: The best prayer app for Muslims
reviews.text: Assalamualikum, First of all I want to thank the owner and the developer for this app. I am truly grateful to Allah swt to have found this app. As it has truly changed my lifestyle. As this app would close all the apps that would make me distracted. Specially the Fazr prayer, I would literally have to wake up and scan my sink to make the “wake up it’s time to pray fazr” yelling sound. Hahaha, considering the fact that I’m afraid my parents will think who’s yelling this Fazr time early morning. They’re also impressed seeing my prayers daily. Praying daily has truly changed my mentality and brought me peace as a Muslimah. So thank you so much to the developer team for making this app, and it’s so helpful for us Muslims.

reviews.title: Best app ever
reviews.text:
My name is hussain and I was struggling with praying in time for as long as I can remember. This app is changing my life… literally. I will try to remember to make dua for the developers when I pray everyday. 
When I first saw this app in an ad a few weeks ago I was in debt and struggling financially.. they let me have it for free which tells me a lot about what kind of people the developers are and that they are truly doing this for the sake of Allah. 
May Allah reward you for this in dunya and akhira and may Allah grant you and us paradise. 
I will share this app with everyone I know who is struggling with the same problem starting by my own family. 
جزاكم الله خير. 
Ps: I will start paying for the subscription as soon as possible. Thank you again ♥️♥️♥️
